rule_incumbent.limitations: Rule-only incumbent with no model weights; single SDK; not an external/strong baseline

tactical_on_vs_off.limitations: Outcome weak/inconclusive; 3 scenarios only; all timeout at 1801 steps; high variance

intent_only.limitations: No config or experiment isolates intent-only scoring. All configs enable both intent and situation concurrently.

situation_only.limitations: No config or experiment isolates situation-only scoring.

no_learned_fallback.evidence_path: ai/policy.py (fallback logic); rating.json policy.fallback_reasons. Proxy: rule incumbent baseline comparison.
no_learned_fallback.outcome_metric: Fallback rate tracked (66.3% empty route moves) but no dedicated learned-disabled ablation.
no_learned_fallback.limitations: No experimental condition where candidate learned components are disabled while architecture is identical. Rule incumbent serves as proxy baseline.

objective_only.evidence_path: scripts/build_objective_labels.py (exists but no evaluation). rating.json shows objective_score component values.
objective_only.limitations: No objective-only baseline evaluation was conducted.

route_variants.evidence_path: reports/v3e_claim_freeze/02_route_reliability_audit.md (route diagnostics only). Route rate metrics in rating.json (move_route_aggregate).
route_variants.outcome_metric: Route empty rate 0% in V3D; 66.3% in full league. No route-on/off ablation.
route_variants.limitations: No route-aware vs route-disabled experimental comparison.

exploiter_robustness.outcome_metric: aggressive_exploiter wr=0.0, occupy_exploiter wr=0.25; max_exploiter_win_rate=0.25 (gate 0.45 passed)
exploiter_robustness.limitations: Only 2 exploiter types; only 4 matches each; not a standalone robustness study

training_metrics.limitations: Accuracy only; no loss curves; no per-epoch tracking; limited training data (4096 samples); tactical only measured once

auth_smoke.outcome_metric: Auth passed (deployment+battle phases entered). Tactical nonzero: ON=3, OFF=0
auth_smoke.limitations: Single-pair smoke only; limited steps (200); infrastructure verification only

auth_multiseed.outcome_metric: 15 pairs completed. Score delta mean -1.27, CI [-50.07, 34.82], Cohens d -0.015
auth_multiseed.limitations: 3 scenarios; outcome weak/inconclusive; no move/shoot learned actions

two_window_promotion.outcome_metric: Single window only: accepted=true, consecutive_windows=0, champion never updated
two_window_promotion.limitations: Two-window success NOT demonstrated despite many league runs. Champion always ai/weights.

prewrite_baselines.outcome_metric: Systematic claim-to-evidence matrix (14 claims); baseline/ablation claim C10 rated partially_supported
prewrite_baselines.limitations: Pre-write inventory only; does not add new experimental evidence; snapshotted before V3D

allowed_claim: The project includes a rule-incumbent comparison and authenticated tactical-on/off ablation, but broader baseline and component-ablation coverage remains limited.
forbidden_claims: The method is broadly validated across baseline families
